methodologyNotes: Covers standalone electric arc welding machines (power sources) sold to consumers and light-industrial buyers at a published US price. Includes single-process and multiprocess inverter and transformer units. Excludes engine-driven welder/generators, spot welders, plasma cutters sold without a welding process, and pure wire feeders. Price is US MSRP or typical street price in USD for the bare machine package as listed by the manufacturer. weldingProcesses is a semicolon-separated list of supported arc processes drawn from {MIG, Flux-Core, DC-TIG, AC-TIG, Stick}. inputVoltage is the rated mains input as an enum: "120V", "240V", or "120V/240V" for dual-voltage units. phaseType is "single-phase" or "three-phase". maxOutputAmps is the maximum rated welding output current in amperes (A) at the highest supported input voltage. outputRangeAmps is the usable output current range as a "min-max" string in A. dutyCyclePercent is the manufacturer-rated duty cycle as a percentage over a standard 10-minute cycle. dutyCycleRatingAmps is the output current in A at which that rated dutyCyclePercent is specified. maxSteelThicknessIn is the maximum mild-steel thickness weldable in a single pass, in inches. inverterBased is a boolean: true for inverter-based power sources, false for transformer-based. spoolGunCapable is a boolean: true if the unit accepts a spool gun for aluminum MIG. weightLbs is the bare unit weight in pounds.
